name: MAE-DFER
authors_or_creators: Licai Sun, Zheng Lian, Bin Liu, Jianhua Tao. Institute of Automation, Chinese Academy of Sciences (CASIA) and University of Chinese Academy of Sciences.
backbone: ViT-B/16 (with Local-Global Interaction Transformer / LGI-Former decoder design)
param_count: ~85M (ViT-B encoder); reduced computation via LGI-Former (~38M effective for fine-tuning encoder reported in paper) [uncertain]
accuracy_affectnet: not reported (model targets dynamic FER, not static AffectNet) [uncertain]
pretrained_weights_available: yes - VoxCeleb2 self-supervised pretrained weights and DFEW/FERV39k/MAFW fine-tuned checkpoints released on the GitHub repo
inference_fps_or_latency: Reported ~38% reduction in FLOPs vs VideoMAE baseline due to LGI-Former; specific FPS not stated [uncertain]
hardware_requirements: Pretraining on VoxCeleb2 used multiple NVIDIA A100/V100 GPUs; fine-tuning feasible on a single high-memory GPU (e.g., 8x V100/A100 typical for ViT-B MAE pretraining) [uncertain]
loss_function: Self-supervised pretraining: pixel reconstruction loss (MSE) on masked patches (MAE-style) plus an auxiliary contrastive/feature reconstruction objective from a teacher (VideoMAE-style). Fine-tuning: cross-entropy.
training_data_used: Pretraining: VoxCeleb2 (~1M+ unlabeled face video clips). Fine-tuning: DFEW, FERV39k, MAFW (downstream dynamic FER benchmarks).
pretraining_strategy: self-supervised (Masked Autoencoder, video MAE variant) with a Local-Global Interaction (LGI-Former) decoder for efficient spatiotemporal modeling
input_modality: video clip (RGB face frames; typically 16 frames at 224x224)
dynamic_fer_metrics: DFEW: UAR 63.41% / WAR 74.43%. FERV39k: UAR 43.12% / WAR 52.07%. MAFW: UAR 41.62% / WAR 54.31%. (Values as reported in the ACM MM 2023 paper.) [uncertain]
cross_dataset_generalization: not the main focus; some transfer between DFEW/FERV39k/MAFW shown via shared pretrained encoder [uncertain]
robustness: not explicitly evaluated on Occlusion-RAF-DB / Pose-RAF-DB; self-supervised pretraining argued to improve robustness to limited labeled data
explainability: attention map visualizations shown qualitatively in the paper
